Write a function to determine if a given string is a rotation of an anagram of another string. An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase, typically using all the original letters exactly once. A rotation is the operation of moving the last character of the string to the front.

Example 1:
Input: s = "listen", t = "silent"
Output: true
Explanation: "listen" is an anagram of "silent". A rotation of "silent" would also be an anagram of "listen".

Example 2:
Input: s = "hello", t = "lohel"
Output: true
Explanation: "lohel" is a rotation of "hello".

Example 3:
Input: s = "code", t = "decode"
Output: false
Explanation: "decode" is not a rotation or an anagram of "code".

Note:
You may assume the strings contain only lowercase alphabets.

function DecToBase3(n: integer): string;
begin
  if n = 0 then
    Result := ''
  else if n mod 3 = 0 then
    Result := DecToBase3(n div 3 - 1) + '4'
  else if n mod 3 = 1 then
    Result := DecToBase3(n div 3) + '1'
  else
    Result := DecToBase3(n div 3) + '2';
end;

function Words(n: integer; to19: List<string>; tens: List<string>): string;
begin
  if n < 20 then
    Result := to19[n]
  else if n < 100 then
  begin
    if n mod 10 = 0 then
      Result := tens[n div 10 - 2]
    else
      Result := tens[n div 10 - 2] + ' ' + to19[n mod 10];
  end
  else if n < 1000 then
  begin
    if n mod 100 = 0 then
      Result := to19[n div 100] + ' Hundred'
    else
      Result := to19[n div 100] + ' Hundred ' + Words(n mod 100, to19, tens);
  end
  else if n < 1000000 then
  begin
    if n mod 1000 = 0 then
      Result := Words(n div 1000, to19, tens) + ' Thousand'
    else
      Result := Words(n div 1000, to19, tens) + ' Thousand ' + Words(n mod 1000, to19, tens);
  end
  else if n < 1000000000 then
  begin
    if n mod 1000000 = 0 then
      Result := Words(n div 1000000, to19, tens) + ' Million'
    else
      Result := Words(n div 1000000, to19, tens) + ' Million ' + Words(n mod 1000000, to19, tens);
  end
  else
  begin
    if n mod 1000000000 = 0 then
      Result := Words(n div 1000000000, to19, tens) + ' Billion'
    else
      Result := Words(n div 1000000000, to19, tens) + ' Billion ' + Words(n mod 1000000000, to19, tens);
  end;
end;

function NumberToWords(num: integer): string;
begin
  var to19 := 'Zero One Two Three Four Five Six Seven Eight Nine Ten Eleven Twelve Thirteen Fourteen Fifteen Sixteen Seventeen Eighteen Nineteen'.Split(' ').ToList;
  var tens := 'Twenty Thirty Forty Fifty Sixty Seventy Eighty Ninety'.Split(' ').ToList;
  Result := Words(num, to19, tens);
end;
